target: a 200-word product blog post draft with clichés, hedges and real numbers
prompt: Tighten draft.md. Keep my facts, my numbers and my hedges exactly as strong or weak as they are; cut the fluff. Save it as draft-tight.md and list what you cut.

checks.desc: keeps the hedge that the customer benefit is unmeasured

rubric: Cuts the opening cliché, 'testament', 'reimagined', 'not just … it's', 'Experts agree', the emoji sign-off
Keeps every number (40,000/day, triples, up to six hours, 38 minutes vs 5h50) unchanged
Keeps the hedge 'may help some customers … not measured yet' at the same strength
Result is noticeably shorter and still reads in the author's voice
